user.title: Grundig Smart TV
user.description: Enter the network address of your Grundig SMART inter@ctive TV. The TV must be switched on.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV. Check the IP address and that port 8085 is reachable.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like a supported Grundig TV.

init.title: Grundig Smart TV options
init.description: Wake-on-LAN is used when the TV is unreachable and you turn it on. Enable 'Send power key after Wake-on-LAN' only if your TV wakes its network interface but stays in standby.
